{{Top|leg}}
'''Platform 1432''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City's]] [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[YL-2200 light freighter]] ''[[Out Runner]]'' landing on Platform 1432 when it visited Cloud City shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The inquisitive [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] dealmaker [[Inkur]] was known to frequent the corridors nearby.
